title: Protocol for the estimation of drinking water quality index (DWQI) in water resources: Artificial neural network (ANFIS) and Arc-Gis
author: RadFard, Seif, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Obtain all analytical‑grade chemicals from Merck and ensure all instruments (pH meter model wtw Esimetrwb, EC device Esimetrwb, turbidity meter Hach 50161/co 150 model P2100, Hach DR5000 spectrophotometer) are calibrated and ready for use.

steps.title: Collect and transport water samples
steps.instruction: Collect thirty (30) water samples from the main drinking‑water sources of the thirty (30) villages of Bardaskan (coded 1–30) during 2016–2017, using polyethylene bottles; keep samples at temperatures below 4 °C and transport them to the water and wastewater laboratory.

steps.title: Analyze physicochemical parameters
steps.instruction: Determine the eighteen (18) parameters using standard methods.

substeps.instruction: Hardness, magnesium, calcium, chloride: titrimetric method
Turbidity: Hach 50161/co 150 model P2100 turbidity meter
Fluoride, nitrate, sulfate: Hach DR5000 spectrophotometer
Temperature, TDS, alkalinity, potassium, sodium, bicarbonate, nitrite: Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater

steps.title: Compare results with national standards
steps.instruction: Compare each measured concentration with Iran’s drinking‑water standard No. 1053.

steps.title: Calculate relative weights of parameters
steps.instruction: Compute the relative weight (Wi) for each parameter using Wi = wi / Σ_{i=1}^{n} wi, where wi is the assigned weight and n = 18.

steps.title: Compute quality rating for each parameter
steps.instruction: Calculate the quality rating qi for each parameter as qi = (Ci / Si) × 100, where Ci is the measured concentration (mg L⁻¹) and Si is the WHO guideline value (mg L⁻¹) for that parameter.

steps.title: Determine sub‑index for each parameter
steps.instruction: Determine the sub‑index Si for each parameter by multiplying its relative weight by its quality rating: Si = Wi × qi.

steps.title: Calculate overall Drinking Water Quality Index
steps.instruction: Obtain the Drinking Water Quality Index for each sample by summing all sub‑indices: DWQI = Σ Si.

steps.title: Map DWQI distribution using GIS
steps.instruction: Display the DWQI values for the villages on a distribution map using ArcGIS software.
